name: Klaviyo SMS
description: Klaviyo SMS is Klaviyo's text-messaging configuration and sender-readiness product for enabling branded, carrier-registered messaging. It provisions toll-free sending identities and tracks their registration lifecycle; actual messages are delivered through Klaviyo campaigns and flows.
agentUseSummary: Connect with Relay-owned PKCE OAuth and let agents inspect SMS readiness or approval-gate configuration, real-number provisioning, and rejected carrier-registration resubmission. The connector pins the eight beta Text Messaging API operations and cannot send messages or alter profiles, consent, campaigns, or flows.

capabilities.label: SMS readiness
capabilities.description: Read account configuration, toll-free senders, and carrier-registration lifecycle.

capabilities.label: Provision SMS sending
capabilities.description: Create configuration, provision a toll-free number, or resubmit a rejected carrier registration.

allowed.label: Read SMS readiness
allowed.description: Read the exact account configuration, senders, and carrier-registration state.

approvalRequired.label: Provision SMS configuration or sender
approvalRequired.description: Creating SMS configuration, provisioning a real toll-free number, or resubmitting carrier registration requires approval.

blocked.label: Send SMS
blocked.description: The Text Messaging API explicitly does not send messages; campaigns and flows remain outside this connector.

blocked.label: Change consent or profiles
blocked.description: Profile phone data, subscriptions, consent, suppressions, lists, and historical imports are outside this connector.

blocked.label: Use broader Klaviyo APIs
blocked.description: Campaigns, flows, profiles, events, reports, arbitrary paths, revisions, and pagination are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Readiness reads run directly; every number-provisioning or carrier-registration mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected readiness and provisioning operations run without Relay per-action approval while OAuth scopes, exact account, pinned revision/routes, bounds, audit, redaction, and send/consent/broader-API blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts eight pinned SMS-readiness operations and attaches rotating OAuth tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay needs a reviewed Klaviyo OAuth app, beta Text Messaging API eligibility, and staging credentials; this worker may not perform provider-console or Railway setup.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register the exact Railway callback, configure staging credentials, confirm beta/region eligibility and legal ownership, then run the full staging provisioning and carrier-review acceptance matrix.

evidence.supports: The beta Text Messaging API configures SMS readiness but explicitly cannot send messages and requires sender-config read/write scopes.
The interim official guide defines eight configuration, sender, and registration operations, fixed pre-release revision, bounds, lifecycle, and resubmission semantics.
Actual SMS delivery belongs to consent-aware Klaviyo campaigns rather than the Text Messaging API.
SMS consent and phone-profile operations are separate high-risk APIs and are excluded from this sender-configuration connector.
